meta.source: Owner decisions recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md (brand, domain, founder, contact). Default assumptions: DOE FEMP (setpoint) and EIA (energy prices), each with its own source below.
meta.notes: Single source of truth for brand, identity, integrations and default assumptions. Never hardcode these in templates or content.

tagline: Size it, age it, price it with the real formulas, not guesses.
description: Free water heater calculators for US homes: size, age, cost and operating cost, built on published formulas and named sources.

author.name: Ali Ahmad
author.description: Independent developer of calculator websites. Builds and maintains the Hot Water Math calculators and data.

setpointTempF.source: U.S. Department of Energy, Federal Energy Management Program (FEMP), Purchasing Energy-Efficient Residential Water Heaters: "For most residential applications, set the temperature at 120°F."

defaultElectricRateUsdPerKwh.source: EIA Electric Power Annual, Table 2.10: U.S. average residential electricity price, 2025 (17.23 cents/kWh)

defaultGasRateUsdPerTherm.source: EIA: U.S. average residential natural gas price, 2025 ($15.34/Mcf), converted with the U.S. heat content of delivered gas, 2025 (1036 BTU/cf)

dateVerifiedNote: Per tool: the date its manufacturer cross-check on /methodology was last run (Phases 2–4). Empty = not yet verified, and the AuthorLine then shows no 'Last verified' date.
